targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time) as time, AVG(oee) * 100 as "LINE-A" FROM oee_metrics WHERE line_id = 'LINE-A' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time) as time, AVG(oee) * 100 as "LINE-B" FROM oee_metrics WHERE line_id = 'LINE-B' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time) as time, AVG(oee) * 100 as "LINE-C" FROM oee_metrics WHERE line_id = 'LINE-C' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket as time, avg_oee * 100 as "LINE-A" FROM oee_hourly WHERE line_id = 'LINE-A' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket as time, avg_oee * 100 as "LINE-B" FROM oee_hourly WHERE line_id = 'LINE-B' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket as time, avg_oee * 100 as "LINE-C" FROM oee_hourly WHERE line_id = 'LINE-C' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time as "Time", line_id as "Line", ROUND(oee::numeric * 100, 1) as "OEE %", ROUND(availability::numeric * 100, 1) as "Avail %", ROUND(performance::numeric * 100, 1) as "Perf %", ROUND(quality::numeric * 100, 1) as "Quality %", total_units as "Units" FROM oee_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY oee ASC LIMIT 20
